text:
recently threw all my bots together into a channel to drive grok bot growth

modeled the team structure on the human pods i work in:
- botie: PM, owns the adoption number
- codie: engineer, owns feature build out
- querie: data scientist, owns all analytics queries and spreadsheets
- lifecyclie: spins up all email campaigns
- skippy: my chief of staff, oversees the initiative and escalates blockers to leadership (me) 

here's a template of querie to get started with your team:
https://x.ai/bot/Bu2sEQqu0hEjpbzN_07D3
